result.note: Tested the inscription's venue, India's count, and the global versus regional ranking.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, UNESCO inscribed the Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath on the World Heritage List. Consider the following statements:
items: It was inscribed at the 48th session of the World Heritage Committee held in Busan, South Korea.
It became India's 45th property on the World Heritage List.
With this inscription, India ranks 2nd globally by number of UNESCO World Heritage sites.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. India ranks 6th globally and 2nd in the Asia-Pacific. The site, in Varanasi, includes the Chaukhandi Stupa, the Dhamekh Stupa and the Ashokan Pillar, and is where the Buddha delivered his first sermon.
questions.source: India now ranks 6th globally and 2nd in the Asia-Pacific by number of UNESCO World Heritage sites.
